description: This Java source file defines the abstract class ServiceOrder, which provides properties and methods related to various order types in the OpenMRS healthcare system, such as specimen source, laterality, clinical history, and other order-related attributes.

classes.name: ServiceOrder
classes.description: Abstract class representing various healthcare service orders with properties like specimen source, laterality, clinical history, frequency, repeats, and location.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Copies properties from this ServiceOrder instance to another, including specimen source, laterality, clinical history, etc.

methods.name: cloneForRevisionHelper
methods.description: Clones the state of this ServiceOrder for revision purposes, copying relevant attributes to a target ServiceOrder.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuingHelper
methods.description: Prepares the ServiceOrder for discontinuation by copying essential properties and setting action to DISCONTINUE.
